note: Survival mode's numbers (spec section 7). Built so far: `map`, the path map of a stage (rules 1.40; spec rules 7 to 12; build step 2); the run's start, the encounter generator, the fights' rewards and the node panels (rules 1.41; spec rules 2, 5, 13 to 24, 26; build step 3). The other keys of section 7 are added by the later build steps. Every number is provisional.

run.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rules 2, 5, 10): the credits each character starts a run with, the HP a character dead in a won fight comes back at, the first stage's setting.

stage.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 19, sections 5.4 and 11.1): what a stage multiplies. Stage s: the bulk target x (1 + bulk x (s - 1)), the pressure cap x (1 + pressure x (s - 1)), credits x (1 + credits x (s - 1)), XP x xp[s - 1] (the last repeats); Elites and Bosses stand min((s - 1) x elite_up.per, elite_up.max) levels above the fight level. Step 3 plays stage 1, where every term is 1.

rounds.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 17): the target rounds R of a fight by node kind; a plain fight at depth early_depth or less is fight_early.

tiers.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 16, section 5.1): each tier's bulk (rifle-turns to remove it over a Soldier's) and pressure (Soldier-turns it deals a round) at equal level, in Soldier-equivalents (SE).

share.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 20): an Elite or a Boss spawns scaled by the party's size N (index N - 1): its HP and its damage; it costs its bulk x hp and its pressure x damage.

map_size.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 22): the fight's map by its units (the party and the foes): up to `units`, a square of `size` tiles cropped from the middle of the open ground; the squad starts in the columns `squad_cols` (the west edge).

xp.about: Rules 1.41 (spec section 3.1): f(d) = base + per_depth x (d - 1) to each character; an Elite x elite, the Boss x boss, a cache x cache.

credits.about: Rules 1.41 (spec section 3.1): c(d) = base + per_depth x d to each character; an Elite x elite, the Boss x boss, a cache x cache.

ammo_pack.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 23): after a won fight (or at a cache) each character gets this many magazines' worth of rounds for every gun it carries, and `cores` standard cores if it carries a focus of a kind in `core_doors`.

rewards.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 26): the weapon pick of `offer` weapons after a won fight, the first for the character's own door or weapon category; rarity by node kind, capped by `ceiling` (by stage, the last repeats); price at most base + per_depth x d + per_stage x (s - 1), x elite or boss; or credits instead, instead_rate of the cheapest offer's price.

nodes.about: Rules 1.41, 1.42, 1.43: what each kind of node without a fight says on its panel; the shop opens full screen (rules 1.42).
nodes.shop: A shop: every calibre always in stock, today's rolled gear, selling, and gives between players.
nodes.forge: The armourer's Forge. One grade step each, cheaper than a shop's; the Relic step and its named property; mods and worn pieces made for what you carry; armour fitted.
nodes.training: The drill sergeant's yard. One big training each: drill on a weapon you carry, study for the Sigil words, or practice for the Outburst; a second for credits.
nodes.shrine: A shrine to one of the eight. Each of you takes one: a rite kept for Devotion, a piece of its lore for the faithless, or its token, a small blessing for the run.
nodes.event: A crossroads. Someone here will deal, and each trade has its price. Take one each, or walk on.
nodes.cache: A cache: credits, ammunition, a little experience, and a pick of three pieces of kit, most of them made to last.
nodes.rest: A safe place: everyone is healed in full and a new session begins. Each of you may take one small training before you move on.

tips.about: Rules 1.41 (spec 8.2): the path map's hover card for each kind of node, what it gives and what it costs (section 3.1); the engine adds the XP and credits it pays.
tips.fight: A fight. Each of you takes XP, credits, the ammunition pack and a pick of three weapons, or credits instead.
tips.elite: A harder fight, opted into: an Elite and its line. Better pay and a better pick.
tips.gate: The gate: an Elite every path passes. Better pay and a better pick.
tips.boss: The stage's Boss. The best pay and pick of the stage; beating it clears the stage.
tips.shop: A shop: refills of every calibre, cores and supplies, today's rolled gear, and selling. Costs credits; it opens full screen.
tips.forge: A Forge: the grade step for less, the Relic step, mods and worn pieces, armour fitting. Costs credits.
tips.training: A training ground: one big training each, a second for credits. Costs a node not spent fighting.
tips.shrine: A shrine: a rite, a knowledge piece or the patron's token. Costs a node not spent fighting.
tips.rest: A rest: everyone healed in full, a new session and one small training each. Costs a node not spent fighting or shopping.
tips.cache: A cache: credits, ammunition, a little XP and a pick of kit, no fight.
tips.event: A crossroads: a trade with a cost, or walk on.

grade_up.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rules 37, 38, 43; section 11.2): the grade step of one carried weapon or focus. At a place of `places` (a shop, a Forge) to Fine or Masterwork at `price` of the grade it reaches x the place's factor; the Relic step only at a Forge, at its own price (no factor), from stage relic_from_stage; per_visit steps a character a visit; an armourer's chit (`chit`, items.json) pays one Fine or Masterwork step in place of the credits. cut_rate: the Crossroads' off-books step (a share of the shop's price).

forge.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 44): the Forge's rolled stock, `slots` mods and worn pieces made for what its visitors carry (a mod for a slot one of them has free, a worn piece better than one of them wears), each at its price; the grade step's factor is grade_up.places.forge.

armour_fit.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 44): the Forge fits the next armour class for its price, until body armour becomes items (Equipment 2.0). The class's own gate (Pain Threshold, a trait's cap) holds.

boon_cap.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 31): the run power a character may carry, in percent of a rifle-turn: its boons, a shrine's token, the graft and the named property of every Relic it carries add their `worth` against `cap`.

relic_props.name: Keen
relic_props.text: Every round it sends lands {=effects.0.value|more}% harder.

relic_props.name: True
relic_props.text: The first attack you make with it each turn is {=effects.0.value|signed} to hit.

relic_props.name: Quick
relic_props.text: Reloading it costs {=effects.0.value|abs} AP less, never under {=effects.0.min}.

relic_props.name: Biting
relic_props.text: Every blow it lands bites {=effects.0.value|more}% deeper.

relic_props.name: Balanced
relic_props.text: While it is in your hand, your first swap or draw each turn costs nothing.

relic_props.name: Deep
relic_props.text: Its door's rolls to hit are {=effects.0.value|signed} more, and the saves it forces are {=effects.1.value|signed} harder.

relic_props.name: Gentle
relic_props.text: The heals and shields its door gives are {=effects.0.value|more}% stronger.

boons.name: Honed
boons.text: Everything you deal is {=effects.0.value|more}% stronger for the rest of the run.

boons.name: Lifeline
boons.text: The first blow each fight that would drop you leaves you on {=effects.0.value} HP.

boons.name: Steady Breath
boons.text: {=effects.0.value|signed} Echo at each fight's start (the most you hold still holds).

boons.name: Deep Well
boons.text: The heals and shields you give are {=effects.0.value|more}% stronger.

graft.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 42, the back-room graft): the graft is a relic made of a boon of the tile's pool and a cut to max HP for the run (`hp_mult`, the stat `hp`); its worth is the boon's.

train.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 39): the rest's small training, one a character: drill on a weapon it carries (addDrill), study (addStudy, a Sigil user), practice (addPractice, an Outburst user), or Devotion XP (shiftDevotion, the Faithful).

training.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 45): the training ground's big training, one a character for free and a second (the most is `most`) for extra_price credits: drill, study or practice (Devotion is the shrine's).

shrine.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 46): one offer a character: the rite (Devotion XP by patrons.json gain.rite_kept), a knowledge piece for an Atheist (grantPiece), or the patron's token, a boon of the tile's pool of worth at most token_max_worth, at most tokens_per_stage a character a stage, on the cap.

lasting.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rules 41, 43): an Elite's and a cache's armour-or-item pick of `offer`, at least `min` of them lasting (a mod for a slot the main weapon has free, a worn piece better than the one worn there; never two consumables); the rest from `fill`. The gate's pick holds an armourer's chit in stage chit_gate; an Elite from stage chit_from_stage may roll one, one chance in chit_odds.

trades.about: Rules 1.43 (spec rule 42): a Crossroads offers `offer` of these trades, each a cost and a gain the engine takes and gives (`do` names which); each character takes at most one, or walks on. The wayside shrine is free and once a stage.

items.name: The off-books armourer
items.text: One grade step to Fine or Masterwork outside the visit's limit, for a cut of a shop's price; the weapon comes back worn.

items.name: A hard sparring
items.text: Drill on a weapon you carry, paid for in a share of the HP you have now.

items.name: A sealed crate
items.text: A weapon of three at an Elite's grade, still sealed, for its price in credits.

items.name: A wayside shrine
items.text: Free, and once a stage: Devotion XP for the faithful, or study or practice for your door.

items.name: A back-room graft
items.text: A small blessing grafted on for the run, paid for in max HP; it counts on your cap.

items.name: A salvage buyer
items.text: Sell one weapon or item from your pack for a share of its price, twice what a shop pays.

pools.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 21 e): the weapons a foe of a tier may carry, by range (a slot names `ranged`, `melee` or `close`; none: ranged). A setting may name its own in place of these.

names.about: Rules 1.41: a foe's name by its kind and tier (numbered in a fight when there are two). In-world words only.

templates.name: A firing line
templates.text: A line of guns behind cover at the far edge.

templates.name: A swarm
templates.text: Small things, many of them, close and spread.

templates.name: A rush
templates.text: They start close and come on at once.

templates.name: A caster and guards
templates.text: One of them writes or burns while the rest hold the line in front.

templates.name: An ambush
templates.text: Nobody in sight, until they are on both sides.

templates.name: A line with a medic
templates.text: A line of guns with someone behind it keeping them standing.

templates.name: A drone screen
templates.text: Drones in front, machines behind them.

templates.name: An Elite and its line
templates.text: One who is better than the rest, and the rest.

templates.name: A warden
templates.text: An Elite who writes or burns, with a guard.

templates.name: Two Elites
templates.text: Two of the better ones, from two sides.

templates.name: The champion
templates.text: The tile's champion and its guard.

shop.about: Rules 1.42 (spec rules 25 to 27, section 8.3): the shop. `always`: the counter, never sold out, at the fixed price of credits.ts priceOf, in shelves (`guns`: a magazine or the rounds of every gun the party carries, worked out per visit; `restock`: the persistent class resources, a point at a time; the others list ids); `per`: how many one purchase gives (a stack of rounds). `stock`: the rolled gear of a visit, shared by the party (first buyer): `weapons` weapons and foci and `items` items in the depth's price band (rewards.price_band, on the standard price), and `rare` pieces in the band times `rare_band` at `rare_rarity`; rarity by `rarity` (the last row whose `from_stage` the stage reaches), every roll capped by the stage's ceiling (rewards.ceiling); `item_categories`: the items.json categories it may roll (mods and armour are the Forge's). `restock_price`: credits a point of a persistent class resource. `max_qty`: the most of one counter line in one purchase.

sell_rate.about: Rules 1.42 (spec rule 27, Leon 13 Nov): a sale pays `rate` of the price at the item's own rarity, its fitted mods at theirs (credits.ts priceOf); plot items and the unpriced cannot be sold.

faces.about: Rules 1.42 (spec section 3.4): the faces of the safe nodes: one shopkeeper per setting, one armourer, drill sergeant and medic for every setting, the shrine's patron. `portrait` and `backdrop` are the art/catalog.json ids the artist will deliver (`*_pending: true` until they land); `fallback` is a world-pool portrait (catalog `characters`; the patron's is the rolled patron's own, `fallback_patron`) and `backdrop_fallback` an illustration id (catalog `illustrations`), or null for the ground colour, drawn meanwhile. `bias` weights the rolled stock by tag (weapon, item, melee, thrown, focus, mana, core, mod); `price` multiplies the rolled stock's prices only. `lines`: greet, bought, cant_afford, sold, sold_to (a rolled piece another player took), gave, leave.

greet: Sign for it or don't touch it.
Chapter stores. Everything here is counted twice and blessed once.
You look like someone who just spent a magazine on a wall. Restock.
bought: Signed out to you. Bring back the casing if you can.
That is on the ledger now.
cant_afford: Come back with the credits. The rifle will wait.
sold: I'll find a use for it.
Back into stores. Somebody will be glad of it.
sold_to: Gone. Signed out to someone faster.
gave: Sharing kit. Put it in the ledger.
leave: Bring it back in one piece.

greet: You didn't see me. I didn't see you. Now, what do you need?
Everything here fell off something. The prices are honest, which is more than the streets are.
bought: Don't tell anyone where you got it.
cant_afford: Short. I don't do favours, I do business.

greet: Mind the mud. Blades on the left, bangs on the right.
The front takes everything eventually. Take what you need first.
bought: Good choice. Sharp end away from you.
That'll see you through the next trench.
cant_afford: The war doesn't give discounts and neither do I.
sold: I'll sell it to the next poor sod.
gave: Look after each other out there.
leave: Keep your head below the line.

greet: Smetanita goods. Precision costs, and precision is all I sell.
Gloves, cores, tools of the trade. The foundry makes, I deliver.
cant_afford: Quality has a price. You are below it.

greet: Peace on your road. The relics are blessed; the rounds are merely counted.
Lay down your burdens. Then pick up new ones; they are for sale.
cant_afford: Faith is free. This is not.
sold: It will find a better owner.
gave: A gift freely given is twice blessed.
leave: Walk in the light, or at least near it.

greet: Air's recycled, prices aren't. Take a look.
Last stop before the dark. Stock up.
cant_afford: Out here nothing's free. Not even breathing.
sold: Everything gets used twice on the rim.

greet: Put it on the bench. Let's see what it could be.
On the line. Again. Until it's boring.
cant_afford: Extra drill costs. Pay or run laps.

greet: Sit. Breathe. Let me look at that.
